content:
watchOS 27 brings a host of practical new features—here is everything coming to Apple Watch this fall.

Siri AI on Apple Watch, with a dedicated app

The flagship feature of watchOS 27 is Siri AI.

Two years ago, when Apple redesigned Siri and launched Apple Intelligence, the Apple Watch was left out of the picture.

Now with watchOS 27, the Apple Watch will get access to the redesigned, more powerful Siri.

That includes a dedicated Siri app on watchOS that syncs with the Siri apps on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro.

Apple Watch will get the Siri chatbot app, personal context understanding, in-app actions, and broader world knowledge.

Siri AI is not yet included in the first beta of watchOS 27, but Apple says an English version will arrive later this year.

It's great to see Siri on Apple Watch finally being as powerful as the new Siri AI system on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro.

Apple Watch was indeed overlooked in the original Apple Intelligence plans.

Dynamic app list launched from the Digital Crown

In watchOS 27, pressing the Digital Crown on Apple Watch brings up an all-new dynamic app list.

It consists of six Siri-suggested apps. If Siri AI is enabled, the Siri app sits in the centre. Icons for the full app list and app grid are also shown.

Apple says the remaining apps are chosen based on usage frequency and popularity.

A single press of the Digital Crown brings up the dynamic app list, and pressing it again returns to the watch face.

You can press the Digital Crown and swipe up to jump straight into the full app list.

Workout Buddy gets three enhancements in watchOS 27

Workout Buddy, which debuted in watchOS 26, was arguably the first AI-oriented feature to land on Apple Watch, but it required a nearby iPhone to work.

That meant if you worked out without your iPhone, Workout Buddy was off the table.

That changes this year, as Workout Buddy now works without an iPhone nearby.

On top of that, Workout Buddy's language support expands from English-only to Spanish.

Apple says Workout Buddy covers more insights, including progress with pace, distance, and workout duration.

Health and fitness tracking gets a boost in two ways

Beyond Workout Buddy, watchOS 27 brings two more improvements to health and fitness tracking.

First, Cycle Tracking is more advanced, with new support for perimenopause and menopause.

Apple says: "The Health app's Cycle Tracking feature can notify you when your logged cycle patterns show signs of perimenopause. You can log related symptoms and get support through educational resources."

Second, accuracy for indoor treadmill running or walking tracking is improved.

Apple says: "An improved dynamic tracking algorithm lets you more accurately measure distance for treadmill runs and walks right on your wrist."

Apple also notes that in watchOS 27 and iOS 27, steps in the Fitness app will sync with steps calculated in the Health app.

watchOS 27 brings a new tap gesture

On Apple Watch, double-tapping your fingers and thumb opens Smart Stack to cycle through app widgets on your watch face.

Starting in watchOS 27, a new single-finger tap gesture lets you interact with widgets in Smart Stack directly.

That means you can double-tap your thumb and index finger to open a widget view, double-tap again to cycle to the next widget, or single-tap thumb and index finger to interact with the widget.

For example, you can open the Heart Rate app from the Heart Rate widget for a live reading, start a workout from the workout suggestions widget, or play and pause media from the Now Playing widget.

All without needing to tap the display with your other hand.

Smart Stack gets new widget suggestions

On top of the new gesture, watchOS 27 dramatically expands the number of widget suggestions that can automatically appear in your stack.

New options include parking location, the Siri app, birthday greetings and celebrations, pinned messages, and more. We'll go in-depth this summer.

Find My on Apple Watch is unified

Next up is Find My on Apple Watch. Starting in watchOS 27, Find My will become a single unified app, just like on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Previously, the Find My experience on Apple Watch was split across three separate app icons, for People, Items, and Devices.

watchOS 27 also brings Precision Finding support to Apple Watch, usable with a paired iPhone, AirTag 2, and AirPods Pro 3.

watchOS 27 will offer battery-saving suggestions

Apple says watchOS 27 introduces all-new battery optimisation suggestions.

In practice, this will prompt users with notifications to disable features they don't often use in order to save battery life.

These include Start Workout reminders, gesture controls, and the Raise to Speak feature for invoking Siri.

If watchOS 27 issues a notification about disabling a rarely used feature to extend battery life, users can opt to override this proactive battery extension notification and keep the feature enabled.

More app updates and changes

In addition, Apple says watchOS 27 delivers faster music playback on Apple Watch.

The Liquid Glass design has been updated with a greater focus on legibility, presenting a more unified refraction effect and better contrast.

The Wallet app supports new custom generated cards coming from iOS 27, which can be pinned to Smart Stack for quick access.

Call Context, a new proactive feature that can surface relevant data like flight info during calls with merchants, now also supports Apple Watch.

Apple's child safety features are also being extended to Apple Watch and watchOS 27.

In its keynote, Apple also listed the following changes related to watchOS 27 and Apple Watch:

  • Improved Wi-Fi connectivity performance for watchOS
  • Guest pass feature for watchOS
  • iPhone and Apple Watch support for GymKit (previously Apple Watch-only)
  • Faster app extension launching for watchOS
  • More efficient water-ingress detection for Apple Watch
  • Redesigned settings options for the Apple Watch app
  • Viewing card balances in the Wallet app on watchOS
  • Displaying transit cards and IDs in Smart Stack on watchOS

watchOS 27 is currently available as developer and public betas, with the final release expected in September.

Apple Watch Series 11 currently starts at $299 on Amazon, down from its original $399—a 25 percent discount. watchOS 27 requires an Apple Watch Series 9 or later, Apple Watch Ultra 2 or later, and Apple Watch SE 3.
